title: Diagnostic Seigniorage: "narcissist", "AI psychosis" and the moderation mint
description: These claims trace how a clinical or institutional term is captured by vernacular demand, beginning with "narcissist", then "AI psychosis" and "verifiable research basis" in the Zenodo moderation case. Diagnostic Seigniorage I sets out capture as demand pressure over anchor settlement and predicts clinical retreat, a capture ordering of the next terms, and a mirror signature in platform role-performance. Parts II and III add historical strata and dated predictions with midpoint and terminal audits, alongside the Platform Erosion Observatory's cohort designs.
